prompts.title: Global Wanderlust
prompts.prompt:
Use the uploaded image strictly as the ONLY face and identity reference. No beautification or identity drift.
Create an ultra-realistic, vibrant cinematic “tiny planet” (stereographic projection) portrait of a woman standing at the center of a miniature spherical world.
Subject & Expression:

A cheerful woman with natural length, voluminous wavy brunette hair, looking directly at the camera with a genuine and confident smile. Expression feels lively, friendly, and energetic — not posed or artificial.
Outfit:

Casual modern outfit — blue denim jacket over a plain white crew-neck t-shirt, fitted blue jeans (slight distress on one knee), and clean white sneakers. Brown leather backpack straps visible on shoulders.
Props:

Right hand holding a white disposable coffee cup with lid and sleeve, subtle steam rising.

Left hand holding a smartphone angled toward the camera, showing a colorful abstract map/navigation interface (no readable text).
Composition & Camera:

Extreme wide-angle fisheye / 360° stereographic “tiny planet” perspective.

Camera positioned slightly above eye level, angled downward.

Subject occupies dominant foreground (~70–80% frame), with the spherical world wrapping around beneath her feet.

Aspect ratio 2:3.
Environment (Tiny Planet):

A small, curved spherical ground covered in vibrant green grass with tiny white details (flowers or path markers).

Around the sphere’s edge, seamlessly integrated global landmarks arranged in circular panorama:

Eiffel Tower

Burj Al Arab

Big Ben (Elizabeth Tower)

Taipei 101

St. Basil’s Cathedral

Additional subtle European-style domes and towers
Lighting (CRITICAL):

Bright, cinematic daylight with soft HDR balance.

Primary light source from top-left with subtle sun flare.

Soft, diffused shadows on the right side of face and clothing.

Even exposure across highlights and shadows (no harsh clipping).
Color & Style:

Highly saturated, vibrant color palette — rich greens, deep sky blues, warm skin tones, and natural denim texture.

Hyper-realistic yet slightly polished AI-rendered aesthetic (smooth skin, refined detail, clean edges).

Maintain depth, clarity, and sharpness across entire frame.
Additional Notes:

Keep all elements physically stylized but visually believable.

No text, watermark, or branding.

Tiny Planet not cropped.

Ensure strong depth and curvature effect of the tiny planet.
